purpose: Runtime-neutral semantic assertion contract for Cinema and Series validation cases.

identity_scopes.exact_entity: Two references resolve to the same durable CAS entity.
identity_scopes.underlying_work: Two references may be different CAS entity kinds, but resolve to the same underlying creative Work.
identity_scopes.series_lineage: Two references participate in the same program/franchise lineage without asserting exact entity identity.

same_identity.notes: identity_scope is mandatory because exact entity identity and shared underlying Work identity are different semantics.

different_identity.notes: Defaults to exact durable entity identity unless a future assertion contract explicitly scopes otherwise.

rules: A semantic engine must never convert NOT_IMPLEMENTED into PASS.
Missing bindings are validation debt, not a passing result.
same_identity without an explicit identity_scope is not runtime-ready.
A Version and its parent Work are different CAS entities even when identity_scope=underlying_work evaluates true.
custom assertions require an explicitly named specialized evaluator before they can pass automatically.
Engine results must identify the assertion_id and observed state used to reach the result.
